svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Activation-aware whitening: truncate by what the model uses, not by weight size
drop the smallest-magnitude directions of W —
minimize ‖W − Wᵣ‖. But weight size ≠ importance.
measure which input directions real text excites (H),
drop what real activations barely touch — min ‖(W−Wᵣ)·X‖.
The only thing that changes is the metric the truncation is measured in.
H = Σ xxᵀ (input covariance) = S·Sᵀ. Factor the whitened matrix W·S, keep rank r, un-whiten. Each discarded
singular value now equals its exact share of activation-space error (SVD-LLM). This repo gets H with real data,
or — the novel part — with none at all (next diagram).
